name: Bosch GWS 720 Professional 720W 100mm Angle Grinder
shortDescription: Slim-grip 720W 100mm professional angle grinder with direct motor cooling, burst-proof guard, and 11,000 RPM for continuous metalwork and masonry dressing.
overview: The Bosch GWS 720 Professional angle grinder is celebrated worldwide for its remarkably slender grip perimeter (just 56mm), delivering supreme ergonomic handling and fatigue-free operation during long shifts. Engineered with a durable 720-watt motor equipped with direct cooling vents, it sustains high overload capacities during rigorous grinding in stone, brick, and structural steel. Safety features include an anti-rotation, burst-proof guard that holds firm even if a disc fractures, alongside restart protection to prevent uncontrolled startups after power interruptions.
keyFeatures: 720W high-performance motor engineered for continuous professional duty
Ultra-compact 56mm round grip circumference for exceptional ergonomics and control
Optimized air inlets and direct motor cooling provide superior thermal overload tolerance
Anti-rotation protective guard provides maximum user protection against disc fragments
Specially developed carbon brushes with extended service intervals
Precision alloy gearhead with metal bearing seats ensures durability
Restart protection prevents unintentional machine restart following power cuts
applications: Sheet metal and hollow pipe cut-off work
Weld grinding and edge deburring in workshops
Granite, marble, and ceramic tile cutting
Paint stripping and surface wire brush cleaning
specsSummary: Rated Input Power: 720 Watts | No-Load Speed: 11,000 RPM
